title: Static-elasticity campaign to guarded surrogate pipeline
purpose: Exercise deterministic sampling, case identity, resumable FEniCSx execution, scientific dataset materialization, independent surrogate validation, artifact persistence, and high-fidelity fallback.

execution.evidence: Serial and two-rank MPI smoke runs must complete all requested cases; rerunning the serial identifier must reuse completed case records.

observables: Deterministic case IDs are stable for a fixed campaign name and parameter sample.
Every successful dataset sample carries inputs, named outputs, provenance, and a case ID.
The persisted surrogate names its training case IDs.
Outside-domain prediction is rejected or explicitly sourced from the FEniCSx fallback.
acceptance: The four-case CI smoke campaign reports four completed and zero failed cases.
A repeated run reuses all four completed records.
The two-rank MPI run writes a single consistent dataset and surrogate artifact.
The dataset and surrogate artifacts survive read/write round trips.
limitations: Four samples test orchestration, not engineering-grade surrogate accuracy.
The current residual-scale uncertainty is not calibrated epistemic uncertainty.
Remote schedulers, content-addressed stores, and active-learning governance remain deferred.
